ai.title: Microsoft confirms Copilot ‘super app’ coming this year
ai.brief: The app will merge Copilot’s chat, coding, and agentic features. The app will merge Copilot’s chat, coding, and agentic features. Microsoft is working on an AI “super app” that combines Copilot’s chat, coding, and agentic capabilities. During an earnings call on Wednesday, Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella said the app will span “both consumer and commercial experiences” when it launches this year. “Copilot is evolving rapidly from chat to Cowork to Autopilots,” Nadella said. ” Nadella’s confirmation comes months after a report from Fortune revealed that Microsoft is working on a super app that blends its Copilot chatbot, GitHub Copilot coding assistant, Copilot Cowork, and its agentic Autopilot system. Along with Microsoft, OpenAI recently revealed its new ChatGPT Work app , which combines ChatGPT and its AI coding tool Codex.

sec.title: Nine-Year Fraud Campaign Clones Russian Company Sites to Steal Advance Payments
sec.brief: Cybersecurity researchers have disclosed details of a large-scale fraud campaign that involves creating lookalike websites of major Russian companies with an aim to siphon funds from international firms for more than nine years.
